sentences.tip: Fewer and fewer + 复数名词做主语；because of + 名词。

sentences.zh: 有些城市犯罪率太高了，人们晚上都不敢出门。
sentences.en: Some cities have such a high crime rate that people are afraid to go out at night.
sentences.trap: Some cities' crime rate is so high, people are afraid going out at night.
sentences.tip: such a + 形容词 + 名词 + that；"不敢做"用 be afraid to do。

sentences.zh: 很多父母希望孩子能把家里的传统延续下去。
sentences.en: Many parents hope that their children will keep their family traditions alive.
sentences.trap: Many parents hope their children will keep family traditions continue.
sentences.tip: hope that + 句子，用 will；"让……延续下去"用 keep … alive，keep 后面不能再接动词原形。

sentences.zh: 集市是能看到当地人真实生活的地方。
sentences.en: Markets are places where you can see how local people really live.
sentences.trap: Markets are places which you can see local people's real life.
sentences.tip: 修饰地点、后面句子完整时用 where；"当地人怎样生活"用 how local people live。

sentences.zh: 现在一起看电视的家庭比过去少多了。
sentences.en: Far fewer families watch TV together than in the past.
sentences.trap: Families who watch TV together are much less than past.
sentences.tip: 可数名词"少得多"用 far fewer + 复数名词做主语；"比过去"是 than in the past。

sentences.zh: 不学一种文化的语言，就很难完全理解这种文化。
sentences.en: It is difficult to understand a culture fully without learning its language.
sentences.trap: If not learn its language, it is difficult to understand a culture fully.
sentences.tip: It is difficult to do；"不做 A 就很难做 B"用 without + doing。

sentences.zh: 如果你去老城区，会看到很多传统房屋。
sentences.en: If you visit the old town, you will see many traditional houses.
sentences.trap: If you will visit the old town, you can see many traditional houses.
sentences.tip: If 从句用一般现在时（visit），不用 will；主句用 will。

sentences.zh: 人们很容易相信那些符合自己想法的新闻。
sentences.en: It is easy to believe news that matches what you already think.
sentences.trap: People are easy to believe the news which is same as their thinking.
sentences.tip: "人们很容易做某事"不写 people are easy to，用 It is easy to do。

sentences.zh: 粉丝大多是青少年的网红，对年轻人买什么影响很大。
sentences.en: Influencers whose followers are mostly teenagers have a big effect on what young people buy.
sentences.trap: Influencers who their fans are mostly teenagers have big influence to what young people buy.
sentences.tip: "……的粉丝"用 whose followers；have a big effect on + 名词或 what 句子。

sentences.zh: 孩子们应该学会如何判断一条新闻是不是真的。
sentences.en: Children should learn how to check whether a news story is true.
sentences.trap: Children should learn to judge a news is true or not.
sentences.tip: learn how to do；"是不是真的"用 whether + 句子；news 不可数，说 a news story。

sentences.zh: 在过去几年里，短视频已经成为最受欢迎的娱乐形式。
sentences.en: Over the past few years, short videos have become the most popular form of entertainment.
sentences.trap: In the past few years, short videos became the most popular entertainment form.
sentences.tip: over the past + 时间 配现在完成时（have become）。

sentences.zh: 很多地方报纸已经没有足够的钱请好记者了。
sentences.en: Many local newspapers no longer have enough money to pay good journalists.
sentences.trap: Many local newspapers don't have money enough to pay good journalists anymore.
sentences.tip: "不再"可以用 no longer 放在动词前；enough 放在名词前。

sentences.zh: 科学家正在建造让机器人日夜工作的实验室。
sentences.en: Scientists are building labs where robots can work day and night.
sentences.trap: Scientists are building labs which robots can work day and night in.
sentences.tip: 修饰地点、后面句子完整时用 where。

sentences.zh: 用简单的话解释复杂的科学并不容易。
sentences.en: It is not easy to explain complex science in simple words.
sentences.trap: Explain complex science with simple words is not easy.
sentences.tip: It is not easy to do 开头；"用简单的话"是 in simple words。

sentences.zh: 这种新疫苗非常成功，很快就在全世界使用了。
sentences.en: The new vaccine was such a big success that it was quickly used around the world.
sentences.trap: The new vaccine was so success that it quickly used around the world.
sentences.tip: success 是名词，用 such a big success that；疫苗是被使用的，用 was used。

sentences.zh: 即使一个结果看起来很奇怪，也应该仔细检查。
sentences.en: Even if a result looks strange, it should be checked carefully.
sentences.trap: Even a result looks strange, it should check carefully.
sentences.tip: Even if + 句子；结果是被检查的，用 should be checked。

sentences.zh: 优秀的科学家不怕犯错，因为他们能从错误中学习。
sentences.en: Good scientists are not afraid to make mistakes because they can learn from them.
sentences.trap: Good scientists are not afraid of make mistakes because they can learn from it.
sentences.tip: be afraid to do 或 be afraid of doing；mistakes 是复数，后面用 them。

sentences.zh: 有些学生喜欢独自学习，而另一些更喜欢小组合作。
sentences.en: Some students like studying alone, while others prefer to work in groups.
sentences.trap: Some students like study alone, others prefer work in groups.
sentences.tip: "有些……而另一些……"用 Some …, while others …，while 把两个分句连成一句，不会变成逗号连句。

sentences.zh: 每间教室都有电脑和投影仪。
sentences.en: Each of the classrooms has both a computer and a projector.
sentences.trap: Every classrooms have computer and projector.
sentences.tip: Each of the + 复数名词，谓语用单数 has；可数名词单数前要加 a。

sentences.zh: 无论学生住在学校还是家里，都应该认真安排学习时间。
sentences.en: Whether students live on campus or at home, they should plan their study time carefully.
sentences.trap: No matter students live on campus or at home, they should arrange study time carefully.
sentences.tip: "无论 A 还是 B"用 Whether A or B，后面直接接主句。

sentences.zh: 学生需要运动的时间，也需要学习的时间。
sentences.en: Students need time for sports as well as time for study.
sentences.trap: Students need sports time, also need study time.
sentences.tip: "做……的时间"用 time for + 名词；两个名词用 as well as 连接。

sentences.zh: 如果你请求帮助，大多数老师都会乐意再解释一遍。
sentences.en: If you ask for help, most teachers will be happy to explain things again.
sentences.trap: If you will ask for help, most teachers are happy explain again.
sentences.tip: If 从句用一般现在时，主句用 will；be happy to do，to 不能漏。

sentences.zh: 网友并不总是和现实中的朋友一样。
sentences.en: Online friends are not always the same as real friends.
sentences.trap: Online friends are not always same with real friends.
sentences.tip: "和……一样"用 the same as，the 不能省，介词用 as。

sentences.zh: 大多数游戏的设计目的就是让玩家想再玩一次。
sentences.en: Most games are designed to make players want to play again.
sentences.trap: Most games are designed for making players to want playing again.
sentences.tip: be designed to do；make + 人 + 动词原形，中间不加 to。

sentences.zh: 在接下来的几年里，会有更多人每天和机器人一起工作。
sentences.en: In the next few years, more people will work with robots every day.
sentences.trap: In next few years, there will have more people work with robots every day.
sentences.tip: "在接下来的……里"是 in the next + 时间；不说 there will have。

sentences.zh: 我的父母和祖父母都不用社交媒体。
sentences.en: Neither my parents nor my grandparents use social media.
sentences.trap: My parents and my grandparents both don't use social media.
sentences.tip: "两方都不"用 Neither A nor B；谓语和靠近的那个（grandparents）一致。

sentences.zh: 有些人把人工智能看作威胁，而另一些人把它看作有用的工具。
sentences.en: Some people see AI as a threat, while others see it as a useful tool.
sentences.trap: Some people think AI is a threat, others think it a useful tool.
sentences.tip: Some …, while others … 对比两种看法；"把 A 看作 B"用 see A as B。

sentences.zh: 树木为很多鸟类提供食物和栖息的地方。
sentences.en: Trees provide food and shelter for many birds.
sentences.trap: Trees provide many birds food and living place.
sentences.tip: provide + 物 + for + 人/动物，或者 provide + 人 + with + 物。

sentences.zh: 由于污染，很多海滩已经关闭了。
sentences.en: A number of beaches have been closed because of pollution.
sentences.trap: A number of beaches has been closed because pollution.
sentences.tip: 中文"海滩关闭了"不用"被"，英文要想清楚：海滩是被人关闭的，用 have been closed；a number of + 复数名词，谓语用复数；because of + 名词。

sentences.zh: 如果我们多用公共交通，我们的城市会更加宜居。
sentences.en: If we used public transport more, our cities would be even more pleasant to live in.
sentences.trap: If we use public transport more, our cities will be more pleasant to live.
sentences.tip: 假设情况用 If + 过去式，主句 would；pleasant to live in，in 不能省。

sentences.zh: 虽然电动汽车很贵，但用起来便宜得多。
sentences.en: Although electric cars are expensive, they are much cheaper to run.
sentences.trap: Although electric cars are expensive, but they are more cheaper to use.
sentences.tip: Although 后面不加 but；比较级前用 much，不说 more cheaper。

sentences.zh: 有些家庭什么都回收，而另一些家庭把所有垃圾都扔掉。
sentences.en: Some families recycle everything, while others throw all their rubbish away.
sentences.trap: Some families recycle everything, others throw away all rubbish.
sentences.tip: 两种做法对比用 Some …, while others …；throw away 的宾语可以放中间。

sentences.zh: 有些病人不敢跟医生说实话。
sentences.en: Some patients are afraid to tell their doctors the truth.
sentences.trap: Some patients are afraid telling the truth to doctors.
sentences.tip: be afraid to do；"跟某人说实话"是 tell sb the truth。

sentences.zh: 家人可以每天帮老年病人吃药。
sentences.en: Family members can help older patients with their medicine every day.
sentences.trap: Family members can help old patients eating medicine every day.
sentences.tip: help + 人 + with + 名词；"吃药"英文说 take medicine，不说 eat。

sentences.zh: 无论你年轻还是年老，规律运动都对你有好处。
sentences.en: Whether you are young or old, regular exercise is good for you.
sentences.trap: No matter you are young or old, regular exercise is good to you.
sentences.tip: "无论 A 还是 B"用 Whether A or B；"对……有好处"是 good for。

sentences.zh: 感到压力大的时候，你可以去散散步，也可以找朋友聊聊。
sentences.en: When you feel stressed, you can either go for a walk or talk to a friend.
sentences.trap: When you feel stress, you can go for a walk, also can talk with friend.
sentences.tip: 两个选择用 either A or B；"感到压力大"是 feel stressed。

sentences.zh: 近年来，经常锻炼的人越来越多了。
sentences.en: The number of people who exercise regularly has increased in recent years.
sentences.trap: The number of people who exercise regularly have increased in the recent years.
sentences.tip: the number of … 谓语用单数 has；"近年来"是 in recent years，不加 the。

sentences.zh: 很多人更喜欢住在小城镇，而不是大城市。
sentences.en: Many people prefer living in small towns to living in big cities.
k: 比起 B 更喜欢 A
sentences.trap: Many people prefer to live in small towns than big cities.
sentences.tip: prefer A to B，A、B 都用 doing 或名词；不要写 prefer … than。

sentences.zh: 现在的城市生活和二十年前不一样了。
sentences.en: Life in the city is not the same as it was twenty years ago.
sentences.trap: The city life now is not same as twenty years ago.
sentences.tip: "和……一样"用 the same as；比较对象写成完整的 it was twenty years ago 更清楚。

sentences.zh: 如果多种些树，夏天街道会凉快得多。
sentences.en: If more trees are planted, the streets will be much cooler in summer.
sentences.trap: If plant more trees, the streets will be more cool in summer.
sentences.tip: 英文要有主语：树是被种的，用 trees are planted；cool 的比较级是 cooler。

sentences.zh: 这个地区的道路和建筑都需要维修。
sentences.en: Both the roads and the buildings in this area need to be repaired.
sentences.trap: The roads and buildings in this area both need to repair.
sentences.tip: Both A and B 放在主语开头；道路是被修的，用 need to be repaired，need to repair 意思变成了"道路要去修别的东西"。

sentences.zh: 尽管房租很高，很多年轻人还是选择住在市中心。
sentences.en: Despite the high rents, many young people still choose to live in the city centre.
sentences.trap: Despite the rent is high, many young people still choose living in city center.
sentences.tip: Despite + 名词（the high rents），不能接句子；choose to do。

sentences.zh: 有些员工喜欢在家办公，而另一些人想念同事。
sentences.en: Some workers enjoy working from home, while others miss their colleagues.
sentences.trap: Some workers like to work at home, others miss their colleagues.
sentences.tip: Some …, while others … 对比两种人；"在家工作"是 work from home。

sentences.zh: 雇主有义务保证员工的安全。
sentences.en: Employers have a duty to keep their workers safe.
sentences.trap: Employers have duty to make sure workers' safe.
sentences.tip: have a duty to do；"让……保持安全"用 keep + 宾语 + safe。

sentences.zh: 如果我有更多空闲时间，我会学一门新技能。
sentences.en: If I had more free time, I would learn a new skill.
sentences.trap: If I have more free time, I would learn a new skill.
sentences.tip: 说现在不真实的假设，前后都要"退一步"：If + 过去式（had），主句 would；If I have … 配 would 是时态错配。

sentences.zh: 人们辞职的主要原因之一是工资低。
sentences.en: One of the main reasons people leave their jobs is low pay.
sentences.trap: One of the main reason why people leave their jobs are low pay.
sentences.tip: One of the + 复数名词（reasons），谓语用单数 is。

sentences.zh: 一份好工作不仅工资高，还能给你成长的机会。
sentences.en: A good job not only pays well but also gives you a chance to grow.
sentences.trap: A good job not only has high salary, but also gives you chance of growing.
sentences.tip: not only / but also 后面都接动词；"……的机会"用 a chance to do。

sentences.zh: 男人和女人都应该分担家务。
sentences.en: Both men and women should share the housework.
sentences.trap: No matter men or women, they should share housework.
sentences.tip: "男人和女人都"用 Both men and women 做主语；No matter 后面要接 how/what 等引导的句子，不能直接接名词。

sentences.zh: 如果你对邻居友好，你需要帮助时他们也会帮你。
sentences.en: If you are friendly to your neighbours, they will help you when you need it.
sentences.trap: If you are friendly with neighbours, they will also help you when you need.
sentences.tip: "对某人友好"是 be friendly to sb；need 后面要有宾语 it。

sentences.zh: 如果人们不觉得安全，晚上就不会出门。
sentences.en: Unless people feel safe, they will not go out at night.
sentences.trap: If people don't feel safety, they won't go out in night.
sentences.tip: Unless + 肯定句；feel 后面接形容词 safe，不接名词 safety。

sentences.zh: 慈善机构为无家可归的人提供食物和衣服，还提供睡觉的地方。
sentences.en: Charities provide food and clothes for homeless people as well as a place to sleep.
sentences.trap: Charities provide homeless people food and clothes, also provide places to sleep.
sentences.tip: provide + 物 + for + 人；第三样东西用 as well as 接上，不用重复 provide。

sentences.zh: 虽然这个小镇不大，但那里的人对游客很友好。
sentences.en: Although the town is small, people there are very friendly to visitors.
sentences.trap: Although the town is small, but people there are very friendly with visitors.
sentences.tip: Although 后面不加 but；"那里的人"是 people there。

sentences.zh: 很多村庄每年都举办节日活动，让传统延续下去。
sentences.en: Many villages hold festivals every year to keep their traditions alive.
sentences.trap: Many villages hold festivals every year for keeping traditions continue.
sentences.tip: 目的用 to do；"让……延续下去"用 keep … alive。

sentences.zh: 很多年轻人更喜欢现代音乐，而不是传统音乐。
sentences.en: Many young people prefer modern music to traditional music.
k: 比起 B 更喜欢 A
sentences.trap: Many young people prefer modern music than traditional music.
sentences.tip: prefer A to B，不用 than。

sentences.zh: 了解一个国家最好的方法之一，是品尝它的食物。
sentences.en: One of the best ways to learn about a country is to try its food.
sentences.trap: One of the best way to know a country are trying its food.
sentences.tip: One of the best ways …，谓语用 is；ways 后面用 to do。

sentences.zh: 旅行不仅让我们了解其他文化，还帮助我们理解自己的文化。
sentences.en: Travelling not only teaches us about other cultures but also helps us understand our own.
sentences.trap: Travel not only let us know other cultures, but also help us to understand ourselves culture.
sentences.tip: 动作做主语用 doing，谓语加 s；"我们自己的"用 our own。

sentences.zh: 每个节日都有自己的特色食物。
sentences.en: Each of the festivals has its own special food.
sentences.trap: Every festivals have their special foods.
sentences.tip: Each of the + 复数名词，谓语和代词都用单数：has its own。

sentences.zh: 很多著名歌手开了自己的视频频道。
sentences.en: A number of famous singers have started their own video channels.
sentences.trap: A number of famous singers has opened their video channels by themselves.
sentences.tip: a number of + 复数名词，谓语用复数；"自己的"用 their own。

sentences.zh: 如果人们读得更仔细，假新闻就会传播得更慢。
sentences.en: If people read more carefully, fake news would spread more slowly.
sentences.trap: If people read more careful, fake news will spread more slow.
sentences.tip: 假设用 If + 过去式，主句 would；修饰动词用副词 carefully / slowly。

sentences.zh: 你可以在网上看新闻，也可以在收音机上听新闻。
sentences.en: You can either read the news online or listen to it on the radio.
sentences.trap: You can read news on internet, also can listen it on radio.
sentences.tip: 二选一用 either A or B；listen 后面要加 to。

sentences.zh: 除非一条消息来自可靠的来源，否则你不应该转发。
sentences.en: Unless a story comes from a reliable source, you should not share it.
sentences.trap: If a news doesn't come from reliable source, or you shouldn't share it.
sentences.tip: Unless 已经包含"否则"，主句前不再加 or；news 不可数，说 a story。

sentences.zh: 无论标题多有趣，你都应该读完整篇文章。
sentences.en: No matter how interesting a headline is, you should read the whole article.
sentences.trap: No matter how interesting is the headline, you should read the whole article.
sentences.tip: No matter how + 形容词 + 主语 + 谓语，陈述语序。

sentences.zh: 如果你给冰加热，它会变成水。
sentences.en: If you heat ice, it will turn into water.
sentences.trap: If you will heat ice, it will become to water.
sentences.tip: If 从句用一般现在时；"变成"用 turn into，不说 become to。

sentences.zh: 第二次测试的结果和第一次一样。
sentences.en: The results of the second test were the same as the first.
sentences.trap: The second test's result was same as the first time.
sentences.tip: "……的结果"用 the results of；"和……一样"用 the same as。

sentences.zh: 植物和动物都需要水才能生存。
sentences.en: Both plants and animals need water to survive.
sentences.trap: Plants and animals both need water for surviving.
sentences.tip: Both A and B 放在主语前；目的用 to do。

sentences.zh: 科学家面临的最大挑战之一是获得足够的资金。
sentences.en: One of the biggest challenges for scientists is getting enough money.
sentences.trap: One of the biggest challenge for scientists are get enough money.
sentences.tip: One of the + 复数名词，谓语用 is；is 后面用 doing（getting …）。

sentences.zh: 尽管蜜蜂很小，它在自然界中起着重要作用。
sentences.en: Despite its small size, the bee plays an important role in nature.
sentences.trap: Despite the bee is small, it plays important role in nature.
sentences.tip: Despite + 名词（its small size）；接句子要用 Although。
